body:
Continue from the [parent #5090 handoff guide and evidence packet](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/8994a4b22c465da5d1231f2ce0c937d5441c3c8a/docs/evidence/r1-5090-handoff-20261008/README.md).

Preserve the exact #5098 diagnostic/control candidate for #5090. Source snapshot `28da479a02b629a906d0bf3fc38c1e639fb68e0d` has 9,878 paths and manifest SHA-256 `5e5acae9d69c8d31c1c440d7a475c5e118d00903fb7a30b7727e51d9b5c44918`. This contains the production correction represented by draft #5112 plus the common default-rollover controls and storage-preflight harness.

Latest Linux census runtime v3 passed all normal controls (14 top-level/38 named) and the caching race controls (6/16). The race harness compiled successfully, then the sampled 4 GiB source/cache/output guard stopped the packet before race-harness execution or DB birth. The whole packet is failed. Earlier retry3 passed both normal/race controls and loaded-row oracles, then failed physical census because the harness addressed root/index.db instead of the actual maindb/index.db. That three-line source fix is independently accepted but no successful end-to-end diagnostic exists yet.

No natural-default-rollover, plateau, public throughput or product acceptance is claimed; N remains unset. Failed packets and DBs are retained. Resume by resolving aggregate source/cache/artifact staging without retuning workload, public defaults or accepted caps, then run a fresh coordinated packet. All commands and fetches joined and Linux111 was genuinely released. This is a draft handoff; no new execution or merge was performed for publication.
